meta.reduced_budget_note: control protocol: 64 image tokens/image, batch 4, 160 pairs, 3 epochs; identical for both objectives

measurement.I: mean pool of final hidden state over image-token positions
measurement.T: mean pool over caption positions (after last image token, before <|im_end|>)

contrastive_protocol.loss: symmetric cross-entropy over I @ T.T within the batch
